purpose: Freeze the execution and serialization mechanics left implicit by the accepted R5 oracle contract without changing its science, gates, populations, systems, or authority.

resolution.algorithm: Strictly parse the exact v2 parent after receipt verification, resolve each RFC 6901 parent_object_pointer (the empty pointer is the root object), require the member to be absent, add exactly the declared member/value pair, and reject any other operation or mutation.

g0.prediction_superset: G0 emits one row for every public query row in its validation partition before selector, query-truth, or score masks are opened; inner cells use selected_anchor only and outer cells use selected_anchor plus deterministic_random_anchor_stress. Row presence and order use only the public superset and episode context.
g0.anchor_fit_rule: This replaces only V1's false-availability global-fit phrase: append the one exposed anchor point to the current-training fit only when anchor_point_available=true. When it is false, parse and fit current-training points only; never substitute a missing value or expose a non-available anchor. All science and gates remain unchanged.
g0.public_terminal: A public prediction terminal contains no anchor point, anchor availability, query truth, score, or complete_anchor field.

identity.canonical_json: All identity material is a JSON array serialized as UTF-8 with ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, separators=(',', ':'), and no trailing bytes; integer and boolean types are preserved and object key order is never used.
identity.contract_id: Use the effective resolved parent contract_id R5-CYP3A4-ORACLE-V1 in identity arrays; the v3 overlay metadata contract_id is not silently substituted.

candidate_id.serialization: candidate_id = lowercase SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array [contract_id, system_id, alpha, lambda]); null is JSON null and numbers use JSON number syntax.
candidate_id.scope: The candidate identity excludes repeat, fold, episode, and scores.
candidate_id.reuse_serialization: F2 uses selected numeric T0 alpha/lambda plus the immutable T0 selection-token receipt; F0/F1 retain null own alpha/lambda but bind the upstream T0 selection-token and candidate-fragment receipts in this exact order.

cell_id.serialization: cell_id = lowercase SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array [contract_id, stage, repeat, outer_fold, inner_fold_or_minus_one, system_id, candidate_id, episode_id_or_all]); outer inner_fold_or_minus_one is -1 and episode_id_or_all is 'all' for a non-episode cell.
cell_id.scope: The exact candidate_id is an input string, not a second decoded object.

fragment_id.serialization: fragment_id = lowercase SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array in exactly this order); it is the immutable private-fragment receipt identity and is not an additional CSV column. T0, F0, and F1 therefore have distinct fragment IDs even when they share the T0 fit/token.

f0_query_identity.episode_id: Use the frozen R2 base episode_id exactly; its frozen material already indirectly contains repeat. Repeat is not appended, embedded, or re-encoded here; it scopes the random seed separately.
f0_query_identity.repeat_scope: Repeat is a separate seed-scope field for F0 randomization and never part of this query identity.
f0_query_identity.serialization: f0_query_id = lowercase SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array [episode_id, query_molecule_id, query_rank]); query_rank is the one-based integer from the public query row.

stage_mapping.replacement: Use these exact V1 scope tokens in every scope, cell, receipt, and fragment; no stage alias or replacement token is permitted.

private_prediction_fragment.row_order: episode_id ascending, then query_rank ascending, with no additional or derived sort key; this is the existing public-query order.

types.query_rank: one-based integer from the public query row
types.extraction_status: empty or frozen R4 status token

private_prediction_fragment.raw_model_only: This immutable model fragment has no complete_anchor, anchor point, query truth, loss, score, or rank-derived field beyond query_rank.

system_id.g0_normalization: Every locked TRACE-G0-MAPL-FIXED prediction is serialized with system_id=G0.

prediction_source.rules: Use G0 exactly for G0 and for every local/control fallback (local_available=false). Use LOCAL for a finite fitted pair-model prediction; use C0, C1, F0, or F1 only when that named control produced its own finite local prediction. No other source token is valid.

private_prediction_fragment.metadata_provenance: extraction_status, similarity, exact_support_components, and class_support_components are always verified from the true anchor-to-query public/R4 metadata and are identical across systems for a row. F0 and F1 do run frozen on-demand R4 control geometry, but that control geometry never replaces these true anchor-to-query metadata fields.

sealed_scorer_capability.trusted_source: Join the accepted R4 true episode transformation with the R2 state projection by the exact episode_id/query_molecule_id/query_rank key; do not derive eligibility from model output, F0/F1 geometry, or numeric query truth.
sealed_scorer_capability.cardinality: Exactly one row for every public query row in the sealed-scorer root's scope: inner selected_anchor only; outer selected_anchor plus deterministic_random_anchor_stress.
sealed_scorer_capability.row_order: episode_id ascending, then query_rank ascending; query_molecule_id must match the public key at that rank.
sealed_scorer_capability.scope: The file carries the exact stage, repeat, outer_fold, and inner_fold scope of its existing sealed-scorer root; no row from another cell is permitted.
sealed_scorer_capability.manifest_receipt: Each existing sealed-scorer root adds this file to its exact file set and manifest output_receipts; receipt records relative_path, columns, rows, bytes, lowercase SHA256, and the sealed root scope before parse.
sealed_scorer_capability.accounting: Opening this eligibility-only file adds zero query_truth_values_opened_by_scorers. The scorer owns that counter and increments it exactly by the count of finite numeric query_point values parsed from episode_truth.csv; complete_anchor, valid_true_transformation, and true_extraction_status rows add zero. Source R2/R4 state bytes are receipt-authenticated, no model target is exposed, and duplicate keys or row-count drift fail closed.
sealed_scorer_capability.join: After immutable model-fragment freeze, the trusted private freezer joins on the exact key and passes complete_anchor, valid_true_transformation, and true_extraction_status only to the sealed scorer.
sealed_scorer_capability.c3_firewall: C3 and every model process receive neither this capability nor any of its fields; C3 receives c3_target only and never receives completion, eligibility, query truth, or a completion-derived surrogate.

population_scope.rule: Inner model cells and inner selection contain selected_anchor only; outer model cells and private freezes contain selected_anchor plus deterministic_random_anchor_stress. Stress remains diagnostic-only under the accepted v2 clarification.

parameter_sentinels.sentinel: Untunable alpha and lambda serialize as JSON null in candidate material; F2 is a reuse process and instead serializes the selected numeric T0 alpha and lambda plus the immutable T0 selection-token receipt.

hash_domains.overlay_contract: domain=cypshift.openadmet_cyp_2026.oracle.overlay.v3; receipt is lowercase SHA256 of the exact v3 overlay file bytes, with no reserialization or prefix.
hash_domains.resolved_contract: domain=cypshift.openadmet_cyp_2026.oracle.resolved.v3; receipt is lowercase SHA256 of the canonical resolved v1+v2+v3 JSON bytes defined below.
hash_domains.candidate_receipt: domain=cypshift.openadmet_cyp_2026.oracle.candidate-fragment.v1; receipt is lowercase SHA256 of immutable candidate prediction-fragment bytes. It is fixed before selection-token writing.
hash_domains.pre_token_selection_artifact: domain=cypshift.openadmet_cyp_2026.oracle.pre-token-selection.v1; receipt is lowercase SHA256 of canonical scorer selection artifact bytes. It is written before and independently of the token, so no receipt cycle exists.

g0_binding.serialization: lowercase SHA256 of UTF-8 compact JSON array in exactly the declared order; this binds model-public, episode-target, scope, episode, cell, parameter, and source-bundle receipts.

canonical_serialization.resolved_json: UTF-8 compact JSON with ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), and no trailing LF; hash the exact bytes once.
canonical_serialization.contract_sha256_meaning: The contract_sha256 field in every token, receipt, capability, and output means the resolved-contract receipt, never the overlay metadata receipt or the v2 parent receipt.
canonical_serialization.no_cycle: candidate_receipt_sha256 hashes immutable candidate fragment bytes; scorer_receipt_sha256 hashes the pre-token scorer selection artifact; the token consumes both receipts and neither artifact hashes the token.

outer_t0.fit: An outer process may fit T0 once for each repeat/outer-fold context after consuming its score-free token.
outer_t0.emission: That one exact fitted model and token may emit T0, F0, and F1 fragments together.
outer_t0.controls: F0 and F1 apply the frozen T0 model/token to frozen on-demand R4 control geometry; they never fit, tune, select, calibrate, or alter a candidate, and their fallback is G0.
outer_t0.distinct_ids: T0, F0, and F1 retain distinct system_id, candidate_id, cell_id, and fragment identities even when they share one fitted T0 model and token.

selection_token.serialization: UTF-8 compact sorted-key JSON object with separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=false, and one trailing LF; alpha or lambda is JSON null only for a sentinel grid coordinate.
selection_token.cardinality: Exactly one token per learned system, repeat, and outer-fold context; the outer process consumes only its matching token.
selection_token.forbidden_values: No forbidden field may be encoded under another key or nested value; receipt hashes identify bytes only and are not scores.

g0_freeze.authentication: Before freeze, authenticate the g0_binding hash plus contract_sha256, model_public_manifest_sha256, episode_target_manifest_sha256, exact stage/repeat/outer/inner scope, episode_id_or_all, cell_id, r3c_parameter_record_sha256, g0_source_bundle_sha256, public-superset receipt, fragment receipt, and system_id=G0.
g0_freeze.source_identity: Retain source_system_id=TRACE-G0-MAPL-FIXED and its source-file/source-bundle receipt in the private G0 manifest; this receipt records provenance and does not change the contract system_id.
g0_freeze.private_only: The source identity is private freeze data and is not a public terminal column.

operation_accounting.types: Every field is a non-boolean JSON integer >= 0; field order is the declared order.
operation_accounting.g0_rule: For each G0 cell, direct_target_values_parsed equals finite current-training training_points.point rows plus one iff the episode_anchor_contexts.anchor_point is finite and anchor_point_available=true; anchor_labels_exposed_to_models is one iff that anchor is available and otherwise zero; maplight_model_fits is one; the G0 cell emits predictions_frozen=0 because only the final freezer owns that counter.
operation_accounting.t0_controls_rule: A shared outer T0 fit contributes one fit to the T0 process only; F0 and F1 contribute no fit, tuning, selection, calibration, or candidate-count operation.
operation_accounting.private_transport_rule: Joining complete_anchor from the completion-only sealed projection after immutable model-fragment freeze contributes no target parse, model fit, prediction, metric, or public-terminal operation.
operation_accounting.forbidden_operations: blinded_test_files_opened, tdi_files_opened, official_metric_calls, submissions_created, transductive_relationships, and inferred_anchor_candidate_pools remain exactly zero.

operation_accounting_table.grain: Deltas are per fresh model cell or per one shared outer T0 process before stage aggregation; omitted fields are zero and every delta is a nonnegative integer.
operation_accounting_table.shared_outer_t0: The T0/F0/F1 process contributes exactly one T0 ridge fit and one T0 hierarchy fit; F0 and F1 contribute zero fits, tuning, selection, or calibration deltas.
operation_accounting_table.prediction_freeze: Only the final prediction freezer increments predictions_frozen once per unique [episode_id, query_molecule_id, query_rank, system_id, candidate_id] row after exact row-order validation; every individual cell and model call emits zero, duplicates fail, and no row is silently deduplicated.
operation_accounting_table.scorer: Eligibility-only sealed_episode_eligibility.csv opens add zero query_truth_values_opened_by_scorers. The scorer parses episode_truth.csv and owns query_truth_values_opened_by_scorers as exactly the count of finite numeric query_point values; internal_absolute_error_evaluations equals finite prediction/truth joins scored once per unique join key.

source_rows.cell_target: training_points.point and training_pairs.delta finite numeric rows, plus episode_anchor_contexts.anchor_point rows only when anchor_point_available=true
source_rows.c3_target: training_pairs.delta finite numeric rows and global_anchor_contexts rows with no measured anchor value

G0.direct_target_values_parsed: finite training_points.point rows plus one finite episode_anchor_contexts.anchor_point iff anchor_point_available=true
G0.anchor_labels_exposed: one per episode_anchor_contexts row iff anchor_point_available=true

C0.direct_target_values_parsed: one finite episode_anchor_contexts.anchor_point per available prediction episode

C1.direct_target_values_parsed: finite training_points.point rows plus one finite episode_anchor_contexts.anchor_point iff anchor_point_available=true
C1.anchor_labels_exposed: one per episode_anchor_contexts row iff anchor_point_available=true

C2.direct_target_values_parsed: finite training_points.point rows plus finite training_pairs.delta rows plus finite episode_anchor_contexts.anchor_point rows iff anchor_point_available=true
C2.anchor_labels_exposed: one per episode_anchor_contexts row iff anchor_point_available=true

C3.anchor_labels_exposed: 0; global_anchor_contexts contains only pure OOF state

T0.direct_target_values_parsed: finite training_points.point rows plus finite training_pairs.delta rows plus finite episode_anchor_contexts.anchor_point rows iff anchor_point_available=true
T0.anchor_labels_exposed: one per episode_anchor_contexts row iff anchor_point_available=true

F0.direct_target_values_parsed: 0; reuse the already counted shared T0 target view
F0.anchor_labels_exposed: 0; frozen on-demand R4 control geometry is not a second target-capability parse

F1.direct_target_values_parsed: 0; reuse the already counted shared T0 target view
F1.anchor_labels_exposed: 0; frozen on-demand R4 control geometry is not a second target-capability parse

F2.direct_target_values_parsed: finite training_points.point rows plus finite training_pairs.delta rows plus finite episode_anchor_contexts.anchor_point rows iff anchor_point_available=true
F2.anchor_labels_exposed: one per episode_anchor_contexts row iff anchor_point_available=true

A0.direct_target_values_parsed: finite training_points.point rows plus finite training_pairs.delta rows plus finite episode_anchor_contexts.anchor_point rows iff anchor_point_available=true
A0.anchor_labels_exposed: one per episode_anchor_contexts row iff anchor_point_available=true

A1.direct_target_values_parsed: finite training_points.point rows plus finite training_pairs.delta rows plus finite episode_anchor_contexts.anchor_point rows iff anchor_point_available=true
A1.anchor_labels_exposed: one per episode_anchor_contexts row iff anchor_point_available=true

A2.direct_target_values_parsed: finite training_points.point rows plus finite training_pairs.delta rows plus finite episode_anchor_contexts.anchor_point rows iff anchor_point_available=true
A2.anchor_labels_exposed: one per episode_anchor_contexts row iff anchor_point_available=true

counter_ownership.target_capability_process: Each process uses only the declared target capability rows and contributes its declared direct_target_values_parsed and anchor_labels_exposed delta once; F0/F1 reuse the shared T0 target view and contribute zero additional target rows.
counter_ownership.prediction_freezer: Every model cell, including G0, emits predictions_frozen=0. Only the final prediction freezer owns predictions_frozen and counts each unique immutable fragment row exactly once by [episode_id, query_molecule_id, query_rank, system_id, candidate_id]; no cell or model call may increment it.
counter_ownership.scorer: Only the scorer owns query_truth_values_opened_by_scorers and internal_absolute_error_evaluations. Eligibility-only opens add zero; finite numeric query_point values parsed from episode_truth.csv and finite prediction/truth joins are each counted exactly once by the scorer.
counter_ownership.deduplication: Stage aggregation sums disjoint process deltas in V1 process_dag order; shared T0/F0/F1 fit and target deltas are owned by the shared T0 process once, and final-freeze/scorer counters are not re-added by child cells or manifests.

operation_accounting_table.stage_aggregation: Aggregate child deltas by stage in V1 process_dag order; inner selected rows and outer selected-plus-stress rows are counted once per stage scope, while shared T0/F0/F1 fit deltas are not multiplied by emitted fragments.

scorer_transport.private_freeze: Only the private prediction freeze may transport complete_anchor from the completion-only sealed scorer capability to the scorer join after immutable model output.

resolution.effective_contract: The verified v1 parent, the verified v2 absent-member addition, and this one ordered absent-member addition. V1 and v2 remain immutable history; every unmentioned scientific, gate, schema, runtime, firewall, output, accounting, and authority rule is unchanged.
resolution.failure: Missing or changed v2 bytes, a duplicate JSON key, a missing/non-object pointer target, a preexisting member, an unknown operation, or any additional mutation is a contract-integrity failure before execution acceptance.

reversal_condition: Any anchor-availability fit drift, identity or row-order ambiguity, source/fallback drift, stress/control influence, private-field publication, accounting mismatch, or G0 source-receipt loss revokes this overlay and preserves v2 unchanged.
